notes: The active Thailand national-team roster contains 23 players named in the King's Cup 2026 squad. The 23 records retain their permanent Player IDs.
National-team membership is stored as a reference on the same player record; future club and national-team listings must reuse the same Player ID.
National-team statistics cover senior FIFA International A matches only. Youth teams and unofficial matches are excluded.
Appearances are populated only where a player-level total and its source-specific as-of date were found. Conflicting or insufficiently corroborated totals remain null and display as —.
Goals and assists remain null unless independently verified; squad selection or absence from a top-appearance list is not evidence of zero.
Club statistics remain separate and scoped to season 2026/27. Current club league grouping remains unclassified until independently verified.
